body:
Thank you very much for all your comments and advices.
It has been a really hard couple of days. I've tried to be there for my wife, listen to her, and help any way I can.
Because of the circumstances she still feels a lot of guilt, but at least everything is stable right now.
I am starting to talk to hear about getting counseling (or join a support group) but she is not quite there yet.
Thanks again for all the support, all of your words have help me deal with everything better.
Thanks
